topics.title: OpenAI's funding round hits $11B first close at a $1.25 trillion valuation
topics.why: SoftBank and MGX are leading a round that size even amid bubble talk — a clear signal of how much capital is still betting on AI's trajectory.

topics.title: DOJ opens an AI task force the same week it charges a deepfake CEO-impersonation fraud ring
topics.why: The DOJ's new Super Intelligence Task Force and the fraud charges are a direct warning for anyone who handles wire transfers or vendor calls: AI voice/video impersonation is now being actively prosecuted, not hypothetical.

topics.title: Another AI-linked layoff wave: Meta cuts 8,000, Intuit cuts about 3,000
topics.why: More companies are explicitly tying headcount cuts to AI reinvestment — a budget signal knowledge workers should be tracking, not just a tech-industry story.
